admission.review: Root read the full dossier, helper, prospective16-control protocol and full evidence driver. Algebra checked independently: annular-mass contrast and gradient, static deficit inverse, mass-sheet Jacobian/Fermat scaling, radial determinant/null and logarithmic-potential scalar identity. All are conditional response models/counterexamples, not new source physics.
admission.boundary: Exactly one invented16-control campaign per specified runtime into new output directories; no native observation/likelihood/probability/optimizer/provider/importer calls, no changing source/criteria after failures, no release or scientific-HOLD promotion.
